summary: Cresud S.A.C.I.F. and A. filed a Form 6-K attaching an English translation of a payment notice for its Series XLII Fixed Rate Notes (USD 30,045,566 due 2026). The notice announces the third installment of capital payment starting May 4, 2026, covering the period January 5, 2026 to May 4, 2026. Payment is 34% of capital (USD 10,215,492.44) in Argentine Pesos, with 0% interest. The filing is a routine debt service disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, strategic review, activist, or restructuring event is present.
